description: This file defines the RecruitmentAttachment class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It models the data structure for storing attachment details related to recruitment processes, including properties like filename, type, size, and associated comments, with relevant getter methods. It serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling attachment data.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object encapsulating properties and methods for recruitment attachment details, including identifiers, file information, and comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recruitment attachment properties with optional parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getFkIdentity
methods.description: Returns the foreign key identifying the related entity.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comments associated with the attachment.
